name: ceramics-drop-print-asset-container
description: Node/Sharp print-asset derivative processor that runs inside the Cloudflare Container (Priority 8 / Phase 3). Deliberately separate from the root package.json so the image installs three packages instead of the whole Next.js app.
comment:versions: These three ranges MUST stay identical to the root package.json's, because the image runs the repo's own src/ sources against them. src/server/asset-jobs/container-config.test.ts enforces that.
